items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Oh yeah we were good friends. He was one of the fellas that used to go fishin'.

ctx.x: but -- I don't think it was him -- I think it was one of them producers.

Yeah, one of those guys. They didn't think I fitted in. That didn't have anything to do with it. If we made the first one together, what's wrong with the second one. But they wanted the whole pie, you know. They hired everybody that played in that category. Now here's somethin' else that surprised me. After a while they reissued my little album with Parker and next thing I know it's "Charlie Parker with Tiny Grimes." They switched it around. Well his name got big -- no gettin' around that, but that's what they…
